news.title: Innovist leases 2.62 lakh sq ft warehouse in Gurugram for five years
news.para: Onesto Labs, which operates Innovist brands including Bare Anatomy, Chemist at Play and SunScoop, has leased about 2.62 lakh sq ft at Horizon Industrial Park in Gurugram. The five-year transaction entails monthly rent of about ₹72.14 lakh once both phases become rent-bearing and an estimated rental outgo of around ₹47 crore over the tenure.

news.title: Patna civic body collects ₹68 crore property tax, ₹109 crore remains outstanding
news.para: The Patna Municipal Corporation has successfully collected over Rs 68 crore in property tax; however, substantial arrears still exist. Currently, 1.53 lakh properties owe Rs 109 crore on the defaulter list. Of these, Rs 30 crore comes from government assets, while Rs 78 crore are liabilities from non-government holdings. As part of a strategic door-to-door campaign, efforts will intensify, and beginning October 1, a penal interest of 1.

news.title: Jaipur development body to crack down on illegal PG facilities along Gopalpura Bypass Road
news.para: The Jaipur Development Authority plans to address illegal paying guest accommodations by taking decisive action next week. Operators will receive notices instructing them to cease these services, with sealing penalties for non-compliance. This effort seeks to rectify widespread breaches of authority regulations and building norms. While students and professionals may feel the impact, JDA is committed to enforcing these necessary guidelines.

news.title: West Bengal government orders auction of sand ghats to curb price surge
news.para: To address soaring sand prices driven by increased illegal mining crackdowns, the Bengal government plans to auction off unallocated sand mining ghats. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari highlighted the importance of making sand affordable for the masses, noting that the risen costs are severely affecting the real estate sector. Urgent production efforts are necessary to stabilize prices and bolster housing projects.

news.title: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India launches digital connectivity rating platform for properties
news.para: Trai has introduced an integrated Digital Connectivity Rating platform to evaluate internet and mobile connectivity in various properties. The platform allows consumers to assess digital readiness before purchasing or leasing homes or offices. Property managers and rating agencies are now part of a unified digital interface. Ratings can be searched, compared, and verified by consumers to make informed decisions.

news.title: Legality of commercial sites to be tested as per existing master plan: SC
news.para: The Supreme Court has greenlit the release of a draft Master Plan for Bhopal aimed at tackling compliance issues. With rising concerns over unauthorized commercial activity infiltrating residential zones, the court insists on prompt action. It mandates that no commercial enterprises operate in purely residential areas; failure to comply could result in property seizures, regardless of ongoing legal disputes.

news.title: Delhi development body issues notice on structural audit of highrises
news.para: Owners of certain high-rise buildings in Delhi are now required by the Delhi Development Authority to perform structural safety audits. Compliance within three months is essential to avoid legal action. This applies to structures over 15 meters tall constructed before March 2001 and those with significant public traffic. Authorized structural engineers from listed firms will complete the audits, with costs borne by the building owners.

news.title: Yamuna expressway authority rolls out 20 plots for housing, hotels near Noida airport
news.para: YEIDA has launched individual schemes designed for both group housing and hotel plots close to Noida International Airport. Each plan features ten distinct plots, each varying in size and cost. Aspiring bidders must apply by the deadline in late October, with final plot allocations to follow in November via e-auctions.

news.title: SC proposes senior advocate Uttara Babbar to act as advocate commissioner in Ardee group dispute
news.para: In a family asset dispute involving the daughters of late real estate mogul Ashok Varma, the Supreme Court has proposed senior advocate Uttara Babbar as the advocate commissioner. An agreement has been made to pursue mediation, with Justice Kurian Joseph appointed to facilitate the process. A court hearing to revisit the matter is set for October 6, aiming for a peaceful resolution.

news.title: JSW One Platforms files draft papers for ₹3,054 crore IPO
news.para: JSW One Platforms Ltd has submitted its draft papers to SEBI for an ambitious IPO that aims to raise up to Rs 3,054 crore. This offering comprises a fresh equity issue worth Rs 1,300 crore along with an Offer for Sale totaling Rs 1,754.01 crore. The capital raised will be directed toward marketing initiatives, enhancing financial resources, and advancing technology.

news.title: Runwal Enterprises IPO gets subscribed 42% on day 1
news.para: Runwal Enterprises Ltd's initial public offering received a 42 percent subscription on its first bidding day. The IPO attracted bids for over 50 lakh shares against more than 1 crore shares available. Qualified institutional buyers showed strong interest, with a subscription rate of 96 percent. The firm plans to use the proceeds for debt repayment, future projects, and general corporate purposes.

news.title: Prestige Hospitality Ventures withdraws ₹2,700 crore IPO DRHP amid uncertain market conditions
news.para: Prestige Hospitality Ventures, a subsidiary of Prestige Estates Projects, has withdrawn its IPO draft papers citing strategic considerations and uncertain market conditions. The company had earlier planned a ₹2,700 crore issue comprising a ₹1,700 crore fresh issue and ₹1,000 crore offer for sale.

news.title: Prestige Estates launches 11.91-acre housing project in Bengaluru
news.para: Prestige Estates Projects has launched Prestige Parklane, an 11.91-acre residential development in Devanahalli, Bengaluru. The project will comprise 1,788 homes with a saleable area of about 1.7 million sq ft and an estimated GDV of ₹1,750 crore.

news.title: Sebi bans Omaxe, five others for violating minimum public shareholding norms
news.para: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has taken decisive action against Omaxe and five individuals for shareholding manipulation practices. Omaxe faces a three-month ban from the securities market, while the affiliated promoter group companies are prohibited from market access for one year. Additionally, Sebi has imposed a hefty fine of Rs 1.92 crore, underlining significant violations of public shareholding norms scrutinized by the regulator.

news.title: Carlyle-led investors invest ₹2,027 crore in Nido Home Finance, acquire 58.26% stake
news.para: Carlyle affiliate CA Sardo Investments and Salisbury Investments have completed an investment of about ₹2,027 crore in Nido Home Finance through a mix of primary capital infusion and secondary share purchase. The buyers currently hold 58.26% in Nido, which will increase to 72.70% on a fully diluted basis within 18 months.

news.title: Signature Global buys 25 acres for ₹150 crore, ties up 169.22 acres in Gurugram
news.para: Signature Global has acquired 25 acres in Farrukhnagar, Gurugram, for ₹150 crore and entered into collaboration agreements for another 169.22 acres. The combined 194.22-acre development has an estimated potential of 6.77 million sq ft and GDV of ₹5,500-6,000 crore.

news.title: Over 40 underprivileged families to get homes in Karchhana under Mukhyamantri Awas Yojana
news.para: The government is establishing a housing colony in Mungari village to support marginalized communities. This initiative is part of the Mukhyamantri Awas Yojana, aimed at providing permanent housing. Beneficiaries include tribal families and members of the Dharkar community, who currently live in temporary shelters. The project will offer modern amenities such as paved roads and drinking water facilities after construction begins.

news.title: Pay property tax by September 30, avail 10% rebate: Luchina municipal commissioner
news.para: MC commissioner Ojasvi Alankar has taken decisive action by urging officials to speed up the collection of overdue property taxes. Residents are encouraged to pay by September 30 to reap a 10% rebate for the financial year 2026-27. Inspectors and superintendents have been assigned daily targets to ensure effective collection, and zonal suvidha kendras will facilitate assistance on weekends.

news.title: Nagpur civic body's panel seeks 50% tax penalty cut for small plots
news.para: Nagpur Municipal Corporation's tax assessment committee has requested a 50% waiver on penalties for property tax arrears. This waiver specifically targets economically weaker sections and small plot owners in the city. The committee expressed concerns about the burden on low-income citizens during the tax recovery process. They urged for verification regarding the issuance of demand bills before issuing warrants.

news.title: Saphalyam flat project in Thrikkakara set for DPR approval
news.para: Thrikkakara municipality is advancing with the Saphalyam flat initiative aimed at supporting economically challenged families. A key decision was finalized recently in Thiruvananthapuram to approve the construction of two towers for 78 families. Issues with land classification had previously delayed the project, but costs have been optimized, with the current estimate at around Rs 10 crore, reflecting adjustments from the original budget.
